{c_important}Blood Wave{/c} is additionally a {c_important}Bone{/c} Skill. It spawns a {c_important}Bone Prison{/c} at its end point and increases your {c_important}Blood{/c} Skill damage by {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|%x|]{/c} for {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"]{/c} seconds when Cast.

{c_important}Bone Spear{/c} is additionally a {c_important}Blood{/c} Skill that consumes a Corpse to launch a {c_important}Bone Spear{/c} from it, draining {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 2"*100|%|]{/c} of your Maximum Life on hit.
